name: Islam
desc: The Quran, the pillars, Ramadan and Hajj, the Prophet's life and early Islamic history.

100: How many pillars of Islam are there?
Five
What is the holy book of Islam?
The Quran
In which month do Muslims fast from dawn to sunset?
Ramadan
Which city is home to the Kaaba?
Mecca
What is the pilgrimage to Mecca called?
Hajj
How many obligatory prayers are there each day?
Five
In which city is the Prophet's Mosque?
Medina
What is the meal eaten before dawn in Ramadan called?
Suhoor
What is the meal that breaks the fast at sunset called?
Iftar
What is the call to prayer called?
The adhan
What is the direction Muslims face to pray called?
The qibla (towards the Kaaba)
Which Eid marks the end of Ramadan?
Eid al-Fitr
Which Eid is the 'Feast of the Sacrifice'?
Eid al-Adha
What is the charity paid before the Eid prayer at the end of Ramadan called?
Zakat al-Fitr
What is the first surah of the Quran?
Al-Fatiha
What is the person who calls the adhan called?
The muezzin
200: How many surahs are in the Quran?
What is a chapter of the Quran called?
A surah
What is a verse of the Quran called?
An ayah
What is the longest surah in the Quran?
Al-Baqarah
What is the shortest surah in the Quran?
Al-Kawthar
In which cave did the first revelation come to the Prophet?
The Cave of Hira
Which angel brought the revelation?
Jibril (Gabriel)
What was the first word of the Quran to be revealed?
Iqra' (Read)
What is the Prophet's migration from Mecca to Medina called?
The Hijra
In which year CE did the Hijra take place?
What is the washing before prayer called?
Wudu
What is the congregational prayer held every Friday called?
Jumu'ah (the Friday prayer)
What is the night in the last ten days of Ramadan, 'better than a thousand months', called?
Laylat al-Qadr (the Night of Decree)
What is the tall tower of a mosque called?
A minaret
What is the niche in a mosque wall that shows the direction of prayer called?
The mihrab
Who was the first caliph after the Prophet?
Abu Bakr al-Siddiq
300: Under which caliph was the Quran gathered into one standard copy sent to the provinces?
What was the name of the Prophet's first wife?
Which wife of the Prophet was the daughter of Abu Bakr?
Which battle in 624 was the Muslims' first major victory?
Which battle in 625 was fought beside a mountain just north of Medina?
In which battle did the Muslims dig a trench around Medina?
Which 628 treaty did the Prophet sign with Quraysh?
What is the Prophet's night journey to Jerusalem and ascent to heaven called?
Which mosque in Jerusalem is Islam's third holiest?
Which well in Mecca do pilgrims drink from?
Between which two hills do pilgrims walk seven times?
Where do pilgrims stand on the 9th of Dhul Hijjah, the high point of Hajj?
What is the sacred state, and simple white clothing, of a pilgrim called?
Which Cairo mosque and university was founded by the Fatimids in 970?
400: Which is the oldest mosque in Egypt and in Africa?
The Mosque of Amr ibn al-As
Which surah is often called 'the heart of the Quran'?
Ya-Sin
Which surah is the only one that doesn't begin with Bismillah?
At-Tawbah
Which is the only surah named after a woman?
Maryam
In which surah is Ayat al-Kursi (the Throne Verse)?
Al-Baqarah
Which prophet is mentioned most often in the Quran?
Musa (Moses)
How many prophets are named in the Quran?
Which prophet was swallowed by a whale?
Yunus (Jonah)
Which prophet built the ark?
Nuh (Noah)
Which prophet's story is told in full in one surah, called 'the best of stories'?
Yusuf (Joseph)
What are the first four caliphs called in Arabic?
Al-Khulafa' al-Rashidun (the rightly guided caliphs)
What is walking around the Kaaba seven times called?
Tawaf
What is the 'lesser pilgrimage' that can be made at any time of year called?
Umrah
In which Islamic month is Hajj?
Dhul Hijjah
What is the first month of the Islamic calendar?
Muharram
Which caliph started the Hijri calendar?
Umar ibn al-Khattab
500: Which companion, the Prophet's scribe, led the gathering of the Quran into one book?
Zayd ibn Thabit
Which hadith collection is considered the most authentic?
Sahih al-Bukhari
How many main Sunni schools of law (madhhabs) are there?
Four (Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i and Hanbali)
Which founder of a school of law is buried in Cairo?
Imam al-Shafi'i
Into how many parts (juz') is the Quran divided?
What are the rules for reciting the Quran correctly called?
Tajweed
Which Egyptian reciter is known as 'the golden voice'?
Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdul Samad
Which Egyptian reciter was the first to record the whole Quran, in 1961?
Sheikh Mahmoud Khalil Al-Hussary
To which tribe did the Prophet belong?
Quraysh
Which uncle raised and protected the Prophet?
Abu Talib
Who was the first muezzin in Islam?
Bilal ibn Rabah
In which year of the Hijra did the Muslims take Mecca?
8 AH (630 CE)
What was the first mosque built in Islam?
Quba Mosque
Which Cairo mosque by Khan El Khalili is named after the Prophet's grandson?
Al-Hussein Mosque
What is the series of pillars pilgrims throw pebbles at in Mina called?
The Jamarat
What is the Prophet's farewell speech, given during his only Hajj, called?
The Farewell Sermon (Khutbat al-Wada')
